annotations.title: Chart for a moment and place

description: Chart geometry for a birth or event moment at a place: planets and North Node with sign, degree, speed, retrograde flag and house; Ascendant and Midheaven; twelve house cusps (Placidus by default, or whole-sign or equal; whole-sign above 66° latitude); and the Ptolemaic aspects within orb (8°, sextile 6°, +2° for Sun and Moon). The caller converts local birth time to UTC first. No interpretation. Computed live from the ephemeris (astronomy-engine, about 1′), tropical zodiac on the true ecliptic of date, geocentric, UTC. Astronomical positions only, no interpretation. Paid tool: $0.02 per call in USDC on Base via x402 (HTTP 402 with payment requirements; retry with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). Free tools cover the current status and the next retrograde.
name: natal_chart
